title: CaptainHec Horse Whistle
description: Summon your horse instantly from anywhere — even across unloaded chunks. Includes multiple horse types, smart whistle selection, and unique abilities like cargo hauling and combat charge.

🐎 CaptainHec Horse Whistle

Summon your horse instantly — even if it’s outside loaded chunks.

⚡ Why this mod exists

Vanilla horses (and most mods) fail when the chunk is unloaded.
This mod was built specifically to solve that:

Each whistle binds a single horse with its own stats, abilities, and carry capacity. The horse inventory is saved directly in the whistle’s NBT using Minecraft’s native format, preventing loss or duplication in both singleplayer and multiplayer.


Features:


🐎 Summon, store, and recall your horse using the whistle

💾 Persistent inventory even after closing the world or disconnecting

⚙️ Multiple horse types with unique abilities

📦 Sardinilla, Xra, and Huesitos with expanded storage

✨ Spirit, Pegaso, Sombra, and variants with special powers

🔊 Configurable whistle sound

🎥 Automatic third-person view when mounting

🌿 Leaves have no collision while riding for smoother forest traversal

⚙️ Fully configurable behavior via JSON (spawn distance, flee range, death item mode, storage rules, cave blocks, and more)


Configurable Options Include:


🧭 Spawn distance range (spawn_distance_min, spawn_distance_max)

🏃 Safe flee distance (flee_safe_distance)

☠️ Item behavior on death (death_item_mode)

🎥 Auto third-person toggle (auto_third_person_on_mount)

📦 Enable/disable whistle storage (allow_whistle_store)

🔊 Toggle whistle sound (play_whistle_sound)

🌿 Ride through leaves (ride_through_leaves)

⛏️ Custom cave block detection list (cave_blocks)


Designed for a practical, stable, and immersive experience — no clunky vanilla UI, no lost horse gear.
